"""Knowledge bundle ``knowledge-bundle/v1`` (spec C §5): models, file IO and validation.

Public API: pharma-lab builds a ``KnowledgeBundle``, calls ``write_bundle`` and then adds
each model's vectors with ``write_bundle_embeddings``; the backend import calls
``read_bundle`` and loads the vectors of its model with ``read_bundle_embeddings``. Both
sides run the same checks. Embedding files are streamed line by line, so memory holds at
most one model's vectors however many models a bundle ships.
"""

## Goal

Let authored Markdown documents be converted into the existing "'`KnowledgeBundle` format so they can use the current bundle import path. Parsing, identifiers, choices, and output ordering must be deterministic. Text before a heading and headingless documents remain importable, empty sections are omitted, tables keep table identity, and document identifiers are unique across collections.

Included: a framework-free `pharma_agent.domain.corpus.authoring` module with Markdown section parsing, ASCII/Vietnamese slugging, section-key generation, ordered section choices, and bundle construction. It uses the existing bundle record models and the existing import format.

The manifest uses the supplied collection key/title, deterministic generator metadata, empty source digests, and document/section counts. Colloquial mappings retain their input order and fields while filtering missing section keys.

## Approach

Place this adapter in `domain/corpus/authoring.py`, next to but separate from bundle schema/IO and chunking. Parse Markdown line by line while tracking fenced code delimiters; only ATX headings outside fences define sections. Maintain a heading stack for paths. Associate preamble with the fallback heading; a document with no headings is one fallback section. Within each section, group contiguous pipe-prefixed lines into table blocks and intervening nonblank text into stripped prose blocks. Count tables globally in encounter order. Drop sections whose blocks are empty and assign contiguous ordinals to retained sections.

Use Unicode decomposition plus explicit Vietnamese `đ/Đ` transliteration before ASCII filtering for slugs. Derive keys by joining path slugs with `/`, falling back to `body`. Build fresh Pydantic records, sort documents by their qualified key, retain source content ordering for sections/glossary/mappings, and use fixed generator metadata so equivalent inputs have the same serialized bundle and digest.

Run the focused test during each implementation task, then run `uv run pytest` from `backend/` after all tasks.
